controls.known_positive: joint upper bound (no forgetting) must dominate naive fine-tune
controls.known_null: naive fine-tune retention must be low (catastrophic forgetting present)
controls.no_headroom: a domain where GDumb ~ joint (har_shift, correctly classified invalid_no_forgetting)
controls.interference: class-incremental sequences induce measurable forgetting (preflight forget_lcb > 0.05)

calibration.known_positive_pass: joint upper bound dominates naive on every eligible domain (emnist 0.735 vs 0.061, cifar100 0.221 vs 0.033, har_class 0.927 vs 0.409)
calibration.budget_caveat: residual headroom is budget-dependent; an under-trained GDumb inflates it (the C1 seed-lesson analog for budget); principal comparisons run all arms at the SAME budget so the substrate advantage, if any, is at matched budget
